D: A meek bank clerk finds a magic mask that turns him into a wild cartoon trickster.
P: Serve the snacks when the Mask dances at the Coco Bongo.
S: the hottest spot in Edge City
Coconut prawns (flour, egg, coconut panko, fried at 180C) with sweet chilli, and thin plantain chips fried crisp, on a silver tray.
the Mask twists balloon animals for the cops

Crisp sharp cheddar crackers cut into poodles, giraffes and dachshunds, dusted with smoked paprika, with a smoky tomato chutney for dunking. Pulse 150g grated sharp cheddar, 60g cold butter, 100g plain flour and a pinch of salt until it clumps, adding 1 tbsp cold water. Chill 20 minutes. Roll 4mm thick and cut with small animal cutters. Lay on a lined tray, dust with smoked paprika and bake at 180C for 12 minutes until golden. Cool on the tray and serve with tomato chutney.
the green face, in pastry form
Choux (water, butter, flour, eggs) beaten with gruyère and blitzed basil and spinach, piped and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed.
M: Stanley's lunch break from Edge City Bank

Double smashed patties with melted cheddar, grilled onions, pickles and a smoky green chilli mayo on a toasted bun, as loud as a zoot suit. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with 1 finely chopped pickled green chilli and a pinch of smoked paprika. Smash each ball flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes, flip and top with cheddar for 1 minute. Toast 4 buns and stack two patties each with onions, pickles and the green chilli mayo.
the dog gets the mask too
Rump steak seared hard and rested, garlic butter melting on top, double-fried chips. Milo gets the trimmings.
W: Bananas caramelised in butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, flambéed with dark rum at the table and spooned hot over vanilla ice cream with toasted pecans. Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a wide pan until bubbling. Add 4 bananas halved lengthways and cook 2 minutes, spooning the sauce over. Pour in 60ml dark rum and carefully light it with a long match, standing back. When the flames die down, spoon the bananas and sauce over 4 bowls of vanilla ice cream and scatter with 40g toasted pecans.
K: 30ml melon liqueur, 30ml vodka, lemonade and lime over ice, cocktail umbrella.

s.note: the hottest spot in Edge City
s.how: Dip 400g peeled green prawns in flour, beaten egg and a mix of 60g shredded coconut and 60g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Slice 2 green plantains thin and fry until crisp. Serve both with sweet chilli.

s.note: the green face, in pastry form
s.how: Blitz a handful of basil and spinach with 2 tbsp water. Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour and cook a minute. Cool, beat in 2 eggs, the green purée and 80g gruyère. Pipe and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

m.note: the dog gets the mask too
m.how: Fry 1kg potatoes cut into chips, first at 140C, then at 185C until crisp. Sear 4 rump steaks hard and rest. Mash 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and put a slice on each steak. Save the trimmings for the dog.

w.how: Melt 60g butter with 100g brown sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon in a wide pan until bubbling. Add 4 bananas halved lengthways and cook 2 minutes, spooning the sauce over. Pour in 60ml dark rum and carefully light it with a long match, standing back. When the flames die down, spoon the bananas and sauce over 4 bowls of vanilla ice cream and scatter with 40g toasted pecans.

d.how: For each drink, fill a tall glass with ice and add 30ml melon liqueur, 30ml vodka and a squeeze of lime. Top with about 120ml lemonade, stir and add a cocktail umbrella. Makes four.
